title: Tesla is finally launching the Cybercab — let’s hope it’s ready
summary: The Tesla Cybercab , that golden two-seater central to Elon Musk’s robo-supremacist ambitions , is finally nearing it’s public launch. The Cybercab operates using Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (Supervised) software, which the company claims is significantly safer than human driving .
